items.title: Moody’s cuts Dave & Buster’s outlook to negative on sales slump
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings has revised its credit outlook for Dave & Buster’s Entertainment (NASDAQ:PLAY) to negative from stable while affirming the company’s B3 corporate family rating. The revision signals growing credit risks tied to persistent operational weakness and execution hurdles surrounding the restaurant-entertainment chain's ongoing turnaround strategy.

items.title: S&P Global and Moody's Have Rated Debt for More Than 100 Years. Here's Why That Moat Still Holds.
items.summary: The two credit-rating giants remain resilient, evergreen investments.

items.title: These 4 Dividend Stocks Turn Customer Loyalty Into Growing Income
items.summary: Some businesses are so deeply embedded in daily operations that customers rarely bother to leave, and four companies have quietly built their dividends on exactly that kind of inertia. The question is whether sticky revenue alone is enough to keep payouts growing when the economy turns.

items.title: Moody’s cuts Botswana credit rating to Baa2, shifts outlook to stable
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings has downgraded Botswana’s long-term issuer ratings to Baa2 from Baa1, citing a sustained weakening in fiscal resilience as lower diamond revenues and persistent budget deficits drive a steady accumulation of sovereign debt. The rating agency simultaneously adjusted the credit outlook to stable from negative, signaling that risks surrounding the Southern African nation's fiscal trajectory appear balanced at the new, lower rating level.

items.title: Moody’s lifts Montenegro’s credit rating to Ba2 amid institutional reforms
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody's Ratings has upgraded Montenegro’s long-term foreign-currency issuer rating to Ba2 from Ba3, citing structural institutional reforms linked to the country’s European Union accession efforts. The rating agency also maintained a positive outlook, signaling that further credit rating increases remain likely as economic and judicial integration deepens.

items.title: Moody’s affirms European Union’s Aaa credit rating with stable outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody’s Ratings has affirmed the European Union’s Aaa long-term issuer rating with a stable outlook, citing unwavering financial and political backing from its member states. The credit rating agency also reiterated top-tier ratings for related borrowing vehicles, including the European Atomic Energy Community and the European Coal and Steel Community.

items.title: Moody’s affirms Fiji at B1 with stable outlook as savings cushion debt
items.summary: Investing.com -- Moody's Ratings has affirmed Fiji’s local and foreign currency long-term issuer ratings at B1 while maintaining a stable outlook, balancing the island nation's heavy debt load against its reliable domestic funding base and resilient tourism sector.

items.title: How High Can Mortgage Rates Go? How Does 9% Sound to You?
items.summary: Freddie Mac  weekly survey of fixed 30-year mortgage rates rose to 7.03% this week—the highest level since January 2025—after the  10-year Treasury  yield surged to its highest point in nearly two decades.  If rates over 7% sound like déjà vu, it’s because a number of other measures, such as Bankrate and Mortgage News Daily, have measured mortgage rates at or above 7% for more than a week.  Mortgage News Daily on Thursday, for example, pegged the average 30-year mortgage rate at 7.45%.
